# Station

Round-start overflow hands out only Vagrant. A player whose chosen jobs are all taken gets Vagrant, or, if no station
has a Vagrant slot left, stays in the lobby with a message saying so, instead of being given another unlimited job.

Entry point: the `StationJobsSystem.Overflow` partial, called from marked edits in the upstream `StationJobsSystem`.
`WFOverflowJobTest` covers it.
